posts.text: This is the California Secretary of State’s website.  Too much time and opportunity for the manipulation of outcome. Congress MUST immediately open an investigation under Article IV, Section 4 of Constitution.
You shouldn’t cancel history.  Talk about it, debate it, celebrate it — but don’t cancel or hide it.   wsj.com/us-news/confederate-…

House and Senate Judiciary Committee must call every top election official in California to the Hill, and appoint Special Masters to investigate the entire scheme.  It was obviously set up to permit maximum corruption.

VERY FISHY:  We’re supposed to believe that 40 percent of the votes in LA county are still in the mail?  How did they arrive at the 700,000 votes uncounted?  Why didn’t they count more votes yesterday?

700,000 still uncounted votes in LA as of this afternoon.  Hard to see how Pratt will survive this charade.  

latimes.com/california/live/…

In that perverse reading of Scripture, Talarico is either stupid or a liar.

And neither is an attractive quality for a candidate who hopes to appeal to Texas Christians.

Video

A national vote counting disgrace.

20 hours after the polls closed, California still can't tell voters who won.

That's not democracy. That's dysfunction.
